The diff is empty under crates/, Cargo.lock, scripts/research/, docs/validation/ and docs/research/glm52/raw/, which is what cycle-03 R-01(b) asked for; the template is not in the code manifest, is not read by validate_static or execute-evidenced-v4, and its sha (bb70347d...) is banked in bound_documents_at_note_head, so nothing that executes changed.

This is a recording gap only: validate_static rehashes every code-manifest file and bound authority document at H**, and repository_preflight requires HEAD == origin == authority.git_head with a clean tree, so runtime drift at H** fails safe before durable start.

defense_in_depth_findings.body: The note now records (D-03) that the six-shard SHARD_IDENTITY_REHASH over ~238 GB runs inside the evidenced attempt, after the owned attempt is claimed, so a drifted shard or a transient I/O fault during the hash spends the one-shot authority and a further attempt would need a new contract generation and a new human GO. The consumption rule is accepted and stated in declaration v3, so this is not a defect, but a non-consuming pre-authorize census on the M1 Ultra (shasum of the six shards against docs/validation/glm52-checkpoint.json, ~2 minutes, or at minimum stat inode/size/mtime against the last banked census) removes the only failure mode that spends the attempt without producing forward evidence.
defense_in_depth_findings.evidence: Closure note D-03_rehash_placement; declaration v3 one_shot.consumption_rule and shard_identity; contract v3 checkpoint.shards; cycle-02 D-04 remedy.
defense_in_depth_findings.remedy: Before authorize, run and bank an independent shard sha256 census (or inode/size/mtime stat against the last census) of the hard-linked checkpoint directory on the M1 Ultra; abort authorize on any mismatch. Optional; nothing in the executor depends on it.

rationale: R-01 is satisfied with substance: the note is a new append-only file; the diff-stat 01d8565a..note_head (and the packet's 01d8565a..55707064) shows only review-evidence files added and nothing under crates/, Cargo.lock, scripts/research/, docs/validation/, docs/research/glm52/raw/; the shas of declaration v3 (269babfb...), contract v3 (7f984043...), binding (c582e3b4...), inert template (bb70347d...) and executor (91e50a0b...) are recorded unchanged; the exact-head CI outcome at 8456f206 (docs-only, native jobs skipped) and at d690a967 (FULL_NATIVE: classify and Apple Silicon baseline success, small-fixture failure only at the V11 --check) is recorded with run ids; validate-contract and machine-preflight PASS on the M1 Ultra at 9f757ae2 with the pinned environment are banked verbatim; and the note states that the operator re-runs both at the bound head H** and records H**'s CI conclusion before authorize, which is the only possible way to cover a head that does not yet exist and is not a new procedural step. R-02 is satisfied: the reconciliation stale reference (f7193dec pinned vs 7af5cd9d current) is recorded with its cause (30ca81dc in-place edit after the binding was pinned at 5e32d68f) and its non-effect (validate_static generation 3 checks only the binding's token, attempt id, mode, live flag and the two selected tokens; the reconciliation is not consumed by the executor); the second alleged stale reference is correctly resolved as a comparison against a different file; no binding v2 was issued; the no-in-place-edit rule is recorded. R-03 is satisfied: the post-authorize, pre-execute inspection lists exactly the assertions of the remedy (attempt id, 154820, 9703, contract sha, executor sha, checkpoint-set sha, git_head == bound head == origin) plus the one-shot tuple and real_event_authorized, with abort before execute-evidenced-v4 on any mismatch and the output banked. D-02 through D-06 are recorded as cycle-03 asked: every expected_token use in executor.rs with file:line and 0 hits of stream::EXPECTED_TOKEN outside test code, consistent with bounded_p1.rs passing authority.expected_token only into the math struct and p1_domain.rs 1304-1311 classifying from authority.expected_token; the rehash placement after durable start stated honestly with caffeinate, a 10-minute threshold and banked timings; the discriminator statement for the human; the citation correction; and the post-run commit-and-prohibit rule. No actual defect was found in the cycle-03 substance and it is not re-litigated. The residual items are recording-precision and belt-and-braces suggestions (the 'empty' wording versus the inert-template rebind, banking the H** diff-stat and CI run ids, an optional non-consuming shard census, how the closure note reaches the human GO given the closed approval schema, the uninlined template-v1.json, and script-enforced R-03 assertions); none is required for an informed GO because the executor fails safe before durable start on any bound-file, head, machine or authority drift, and everything that decides success (authority.expected_token minted from a contract whose one_shot is enforced against the compiled constant 154820) is unchanged since cycle 03. The domain is fit for exactly one human GO for one bounded M1 Ultra native P1 under execute-evidenced-v4, mandatory stop, no retry, no resume, with readiness_head bound to the commit that adds this cycle's evidence on top of 557070643c. The human's prior GO was not treated as evidence.
